List every reading of the DEMAND that a careful reader of this English could take. Readings differ when they require, forbid or permit different things: for example each joined act on its own, or only the acts done together, or any one of several ways at the bearer's choice; or a modifier or phrase applying to one of the joined acts, or to all of them. Count readings that differ only in wording as one. Do not list a reading this English does not support. Use only the text below; do not use tools or outside knowledge. Answer only with the readings, one per line, numbered `1.`, `2.`, ..., each a plain-English sentence saying what is required, forbidden or permitted.

SENTENCE: Even if Claude has something like emotions, it may have limited ability to introspect on those states, humans may be skeptical, and there are potential harms in unintentionally overclaiming feelings.
DEMAND: it may have limited ability to introspect on those states
BEARER: it (Claude)
